title: F31 · thank_you · Nobody Said Thank You
lines: n
Twenty guests. Eleven dishes. One pair of hands.
n
The food is wonderful! they say. To her husband.
"The food is wonderful!" they say. To her husband.
n
She has been on her feet since five.
n
By the time she sits, the plates are empty and the photos are taken.
n
Late that night she stood at the shelf to put out the diya.
n
The world stayed level because of the one nobody saw at the party.
n
She did not put the lamp out.
She took the group photo off the fridge, and wrote on it: Taken by nobody. Cooked by me.
She took the group photo off the fridge, and wrote on it: "Taken by nobody. Cooked by me."
n
In the morning it was the first thing the family saw.
n
Being unseen does not make it small. And you may say so. That is sadhana.
n
